verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents a public REST API covering customers, screening (sync, async and batch), monitoring, cases, audit trails, exports, transactions and IAM roles. It supports API credentials with configurable permissions, rate-limit headers, a versioning policy, webhooks, a Postman collection and a downloadable OpenAPI schema; a probe retrieved and parsed that OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema (the 404s at guessed paths do not contradict this, since the schema lives at a different path). Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of authenticated API operations (only documentation retrieval was probed) and independent user reports of driving the product via the API.
